users.bulkDeleteType: Type the number of accounts to confirm:
users.bulkFailed: The deletion did not finish. The list was reloaded; try the rest again.

user.name: Name
user.lockMessage: @{{userName}} cannot sign in, their open session ends within a minute, and their shared collections are hidden while the lock lasts.
user.unlockMessage: @{{userName}} can sign in again; their shared collections become visible again.
user.unlockTemporaryMessage: The temporary lockout after failed sign-ins ends; @{{userName}} can sign in right away.
user.deleteMessage: @{{userName}}'s account is deleted right away with all their collections, coins, photos and share links. This cannot be undone. The audit log will show them as "Deleted user".
user.adminNote: Admins cannot be locked or deleted in the panel; they are removed from the configuration.
user.confirmEmailTitle: Mark the email address as verified
user.confirmEmailMessage: The address of @{{userName}} ({{email}}) counts as verified: the limits go and the account is not deleted. Only do this when you are sure the address is theirs.

privateNotListed.other: {{count}} private collections are not listed; the panel shows no private content.

collections.open: Open the collection in a new tab
collections.hideMessage: "{{name}}" is made private, its share link is removed, and the owner cannot share it again until the lock is lifted.
collections.unhideMessage: "{{name}}" stays private; the owner can share it again if they want.

note.label: Note (optional)

settings.publicText: A collection can be public only when every coin has a national side photo and at least the number of coins below has one.

impact.one: With this value, {{count}} public collection falls below the minimum. It stays public; the first change that lowers its photographed coins makes it link only.
impact.other: With this value, {{count}} public collections fall below the minimum. They stay public; the first change that lowers their photographed coins makes them link only.

settings.unverifiedText: An account that has not verified its email address cannot open another collection or share collections, and holds at most the number of coins below. Lowering the value deletes no one's coins; accounts above it cannot add new ones. An account that stays unverified is deleted with its content once the time below has passed (not admins or locked accounts).
settings.unverifiedMaxCoinsHint: Between {{min}} and {{max}}. 0: no coins before verifying.
settings.unverifiedLifetimeDaysHint: From sign-up, between {{min}} and {{max}}. 0: accounts are not deleted. A reminder email is attempted 7 days and 1 day before; no account is deleted sooner than a day after its first reminder attempt.
settings.unchanged: The values have not changed; there is nothing to save.

names.UnverifiedMaxCoins: Max. coins of an unverified account

verification.title: Verification email (one-time)
verification.text: Sends the accounts from before email verification an email asking them to confirm their address. Each account gets it once; locked accounts are left out. It sends in the background, one email every few seconds. Make sure sending email works on the live site first.
verification.nothing: No accounts left to send to.

confirmMessage.one: A verification email goes to {{count}} account. Each account gets it once.
confirmMessage.other: A verification email goes to {{count}} accounts. Each account gets it once.

verification.failed: The sending could not be started. Reload the page and try again.
